Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Glam Soft Faux Fur Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Grey
Colors: Grey
Add a touch of luxurious texture to your room with this plush pillow. Amazingly soft faux fur exudes a bit of glam along with warmth and coziness. The modern grey color will enhance your transitional or modern-style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat.
